en.headline: Two cars collide on North Lantau Highway near Siu Ho Wan; four injured
en.dek: Two private cars crashed while heading towards the airport at about 7:03am on Sunday, with one vehicle overturning; police are investigating.
body: Two private cars collided on the North Lantau Highway near Siu Ho Wan at about 7:03 a.m. on Sunday while travelling towards the airport, police said.
One of the cars overturned. Emergency services were called after reports that people were trapped, but rescuers found no one trapped when they arrived.
Four people were injured in the crash. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山公路近小蠔灣兩車相撞 一人翻側四傷
zh.dek: 周日早上約7時03分，兩輛私家車沿北大嶼山公路往機場方向行駛至近小蠔灣時相撞，其中一輛翻側，警方正調查。
body: 警方表示，周日早上約7時03分，兩輛私家車沿北大嶼山公路往機場方向行駛，當駛至近小蠔灣時相撞。
其中一輛私家車翻側。救援人員接報指有人被困車上，到場後發現無人被困。
意外中共4人受傷。警方正調查事故原因。
